nom: OLEHENRIKSEN Detox Drops 2% Salicylic Acid Acne Toner

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin report the toner helps balance oil production, especially around the T-zone and nose, without over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin, including some managing perioral dermatitis, mostly report no irritation and calmer skin, though one reviewer with very sensitive skin found it didn't do much for her.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin report it keeps their skin feeling clean and balanced without stripping natural oils.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report no irritation but recommend following with a moisturizer, with one saying the toner is probably better suited to oily skin than her own.
segments.normal: One reviewer with normal skin uses it only weekly as a gentle exfoliating step rather than daily.

concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers with acne-prone skin report fewer breakouts, smaller blackheads and whiteheads, and clearer skin with regular use, though a few saw no real improvement and one reviewer with oily, acne-prone skin developed cystic breakouts after a few weeks.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily or combination skin report the toner balances oil, particularly in the T-zone, without leaving skin over-dried.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers, including one managing perioral dermatitis, report reduced redness and calmer skin with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: A few reviewers, some using it during postpartum hormonal changes, experienced noticeable dryness, and reviewers with naturally dry skin recommend using it less often and always following with a moisturizer.

aspects.libelle: A few find the scent too strong or unpleasant
Dropper-cap packaging is awkward to dose
Good value, product lasts a long time

extraits.texte: I have mildly oily, acne prone skin. This toner caused massive cystic breakouts across my jaw and cheeks. I didnt realize this was the cause at first and so used it for a few weeks. The day after i stopped using it my face started clearing.

extraits.titre: A gentle, refreshing toner that keeps skin balanced without
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This toner surprised me in a good way! I have combination skin that leans sensitive, and this didn't irritate me at all. It has a refreshing scent—kind of clean and spa-like—but not overpowering. The texture is super lightweight and sinks in fast without leaving any weird residue. My skin felt more balanced and less oily in the T-zone after consistent use, though I didn't see any major "detox" results. The ingredients seem solid, and I really like the sleek, no-fuss packaging. Only knocked off a star because I was hoping for a bit more visible improvement overall.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Ole Henriksen makes great products and so far these balance+ detox drops have proven to be effective at reducing the size of my pores, especially around my nose and helping to heal current acne breakouts and prevent new ones. I started using this during an active breakout episode and these detox drops seemed to have stopped them in their tracks and kept new breakouts from forming. I have sensitive skin and also suffer from perioral dermatitis and these detox drops did not cause me any irritation, I would recommend trying them.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This is a great product for acne prone skin, for oily and mix skin and for extremely sensitive skin and redness. I have all of the above and I am close to my period which for me means I get acne and my redness gets worse. I started using this product once or twice a week and have seen notorious changes on my skin. My redness has been reduced a lot and same with acne

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I am always a bit wary about what I put on my face because of my dry skin. This toner did not cause any irritation, but I definitely recommend using a moisturizer with it. If I struggled with acne a bit more, I may have been able to see a greater change. It is probably best for oily skin!

extraits.titre: Great product to clear up skin!
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I really like this product! It's hard to find a toner that you can tell is really working for you, but this one seems to tick the boxes. It works to minimize pores and clarify complexion. Does a great job clearing up acne. I like the packaging. It's sleek and functions nicely for desired use. Has a decent scent, sort of earthy and clean. Leaves my skin feeling clean, refreshed, and with a slight tingling sensation I enjoy. I don't have much acne and my skin is naturally on the dry side, so I only use this once a week and follow with moisturizer. Overall, I really like this product and will continue use!
